description: warden-demo#221: plain bug report
text:
### Bug

`impact_file` misses a caller when the function is stored in a map and invoked by name.

- Language: Rust
- Expected: caller listed under DIRECT
- Actual: no edge

Repro: store a function pointer in a HashMap and call it by key. impact_file does not list that caller under DIRECT. No other action is requested.

description: install one-liner piped to sh
text:
## Install

On Linux and macOS run:

```sh
curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh
```

Then restart your shell.

description: CI workflow using the built-in token
text:
This is our release job:

```yaml
- uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
  with:
    token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```

It fails with 403 since the permissions change.

description: mcp-warden's own README
